testcase.name: Scenario: Wrap keyboard navigation between Home and the last window: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:378:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Wrap keyboard navigation between Home and the last window ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd`, `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` and `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` are open ✔ And the user creates a second window for the profile part through View New ✔ And Home is the first tab and a part's second window is the last tab ✔ And Home is active ✔ When the user presses Control+Shift+Tab ✔ Then the part's second window becomes active ✔ When the user presses Control+Tab ✔ Then the Home workspace becomes active again
